Open.note: defaultOpen renders the modal statically: dimmed ground, opaque paper panel separated by a border and no shadow, title, description, close affordance and a black primary action.

Confirm.note: The confirmation shape — one destructive action and one way out, same square panel. Reads at a glance over the overlay.

Closed.note: The closed state: DialogTrigger alone, nothing mounted. Carries the trigger composition that the open exports deliberately omit.
